:''If you were looking for a character from [[Pokémon Adventures]], known under a non-canonical name of Roger, see [[Riley (Adventures)]].'' {{samename|Roger from {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|video game}} and {{DetPikMov|its film adaptation}}|Roger Clifford}} ---- [[File:Roger.png|thumb|250px|Roger, {{Ash}}, and {{AP|Pikachu}}]] '''Roger''' (Japanese: '''ジョン''' ''John'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP090|Stage Fight!]]''. He was the organizer of the Pokémon Showboat, where {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} would act out a play and humans would provide the voices of them. One night, {{TRT}} came aboard the boat and tried to steal all the Pokémon. In the ensuing {{pkmn|battle}}, {{TP|James|Weezing}} used a {{m|Smokescreen}} attack. Initially, it didn't appear to affect anything, but the next day, Roger had lost his voice because of it and could not perform his part in the show. [[Kay]], another member of the Pokémon Showboat, convinced {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to help out. Ash took Roger's place and the performance went on without any problems. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ===Status unknown=== These Pokémon, along with [[Kay]]'s {{p|Raichu}}, are present on the Pokémon Showboat. However, it is uncertain which of these Pokémon belonged to Roger. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Showboat Crew |pkmn=Clefable |type1=Normal |img=Showboat Crew Clefable.png |epnum=EP090 |epname=Stage Fight! |vajp= |vaen= |desc=A {{p|Clefable}} was one of the Pokémon that partook in the Pokémon Showboat, where it played the role of {{p|Hitmonchan}}'s and {{p|Machoke}}'s love interest. Later, when {{TRT}} took over the floating theater, one of the human actors played Clefable to trick Team Rocket into believing that they could talk to throw the trio off guard.
